navDesc.groupBranches: Entities, regions, branches, who runs them and who approves what

entity.hint: Each company of the group, and each franchise partner, with its own tax number.
entity.kindHint: A franchise sees only its own branches.
entity.emptyBody: Add one for each company or franchise partner. A single company needs none.

region.hint: Group branches by area, as deep as you need (State → City → Zone).
region.emptyBody: Regions let an area manager look after several branches.

branch.hint: Every outlet, kitchen, store, office and hotel, with the people who run it.

branches.timezoneHint: Only for a branch outside the company's time zone, like Asia/Dubai.
branches.managersHint: They see this branch's work and are asked first where a route says "Branch manager".
branches.areaManagersHint: They see every branch of this region and the regions inside it.

unset.hr.leave: Not set: the person's HOD decides, and HR can decide any leave.
unset.hr.correction: Not set: the person's HOD or HR decides.
unset.ims.adjustment: Not set: the approvers listed in Inventory decide.
unset.slip: Not set: the receiver and approver chosen in the Help Slip flow.
unset.ticket: Not set: the coordinator, then the HOD and the owner.

route.intro: You decide who approves. For each kind of request, set who is asked first, who next, and from what amount. One answer decides the request. The owner can always decide.
route.title: Who approves: {{kind}}
route.placeHint: A branch's own steps win over its entity's, and those over the group's.
route.skipIfEmpty: If nobody holds this place, go to the next step (otherwise the request waits here)
route.rules: Nobody decides their own request. With "from amount", a request of that size starts at that step and the steps before it are left out.
route.checkHint: Pick a person to see who their request would go to, by the routes saved now.

copy.button: Open a new branch like this one
copy.title: New branch like {{name}}
copy.what: The new branch gets the same kind, region, entity, stock locations, approval steps and checklists.
copy.name: Name of the new branch
copy.after: People are not copied. Afterwards choose its manager, add its people and pick who does each checklist there.
copy.done: Opened. Copied {{locations}} stock locations, {{routes}} approval routes and {{checklists}} checklists.

close.title: Close {{name}}
close.what: A closed branch leaves every list and picker. Finished work keeps showing it. This can't be undone here.
close.clear: Nothing is left at this branch. It can be closed.

chkBranch.title: A run for each branch
chkBranch.hint: Pick branches to give each its own runs, done by its own people at its own time. The people above are then not used.
chkBranch.doers: Who does it at this branch

engineBranch.title: For one branch
engineBranch.hint: A branch can have its own people for this. Times and rules stay the same everywhere.

outlets.title: Outlet comparison
outlets.subtitle: Your branches side by side, best first
outlets.emptyBody: Add branches in System Master → Branches.
outlets.how: Score = the average of attendance, checklists done (100 − missed) and tasks on time, for the parts that have data. A branch's numbers come from its own people and the work that belongs to it.

navDesc.outlets: Branches side by side: attendance, checklists, tickets, on-time work

branchPlace.label: For which branch
branchPlace.hint: People of other branches won't see it.

hint.entity: INV/RJ/26-27/0001 — each GSTIN counts its own
hint.branch: INV/LAKE/26-27/0001 — each branch counts its own

hrBranch.otherBranch: Buddy can be from another branch

payEntity.label: Payroll for
payEntity.missingRates: No exchange rate is typed for {{list}} this month, so that pay is not in this rupee total. Add it in System Master → Branches → Exchange rates.

rates.intro: One rate per currency per month: how many rupees one unit is worth. Group totals are shown in rupees with it.
rates.emptyBody: Exchange rates are needed only once a legal entity uses another currency.

taxProfile.hint: Filled by your accountant. Nothing about any country's tax is built in.
taxProfile.idLabel: What the tax number is called
taxProfile.note: Line the law wants on papers
